text:
maria: Heads up — planning a small rollout to steer some low-latency traffic to the new cost-tier. Want to dry-run + telemetry gate it. sanity-check?
jeremy: paste the config diff pls so we can confirm mapping.
sam: short plan: staging shadow -> telemetry gate -> staged quota reservoir shrink -> gradual increase -> rollback hooks. keep sample small.
maria: minimal change: ```json {"route": "user-chat", "priority": "prefer_fast", "fallback_policy": "tier_b_if_timeout", "cohort_sampling": 0.1} ```
maria: question: console dry-run actually forwards requests or only simulates matching?
jeremy: console dry-run simulates only. use /api/v1/configs/dryrun with enable_shadow=true for forwarded copies.
sam: and make it telemetry-gated. watch p95 + 5xx and keep reservoir limits tight.
maria: how to author the telemetry gate? any example?
jeremy: gate schema minimal example: 
```yaml
gate_name: route_priority_health
metrics:
  - name: 5xx_rate
    threshold: 0.5
    window: 5m
  - name: p95_latency_pct
    threshold: 3.0
    window: 10m
action: pause_rollout
```
jeremy: attach that to rollout object; engine auto-pauses and notifies when thresholds hit.
maria: two ops Qs: (1) quota approach — shrink reservoir or lower per-token? (2) quick dashboard for SRE diff?
sam: (1) shrink reservoir to 80% for 24h, then +5% every 12h if stable. (2) Lina — can you add a delta tile with cohort p95, 5xx, token consumption, error-budget?
lina: doing it now. will include a burn gauge. ~30m ETA.
maria: smoke curl for dryrun: ```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/configs/dryrun \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DRYRUN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"config_id":"route-priority-v3","enable_shadow":true,"sample":0.05}'
```
jeremy: tag metadata {"reason":"routing-priority-experiment","owner":"maria"} so telemetry ledger links easy.
sam: add transient fallback_override=true TTL=1h so we can immediately force old behavior on spikes.
ops-bot: automated rule `error_budget_rule_v2` can revert to last stable commit and post to #release-war-room if error-budget-burn > 10% in 1h. needs opt-in in rollout.
jeremy: enable that opt-in for this rollout. also include observability_links in rollout for pager duty.
maria: plan: staging 5% sample for 2h, verify via Lina's dashboard, then 20% for 6h with telemetry gate. quota reservoir at 80% through 24h.
sam: run Optimize -> simulate cost so finance gets a note.
lina: draft dashboard posted: https://console.redwood/dashboards/d/abc123/route-priority-diff — cohort delta mode included.
maria: starting dryrun now, will paste job id.
ops-bot: Canary job started for config route-priority-v3 (job id 202304-8891). Shadow sampling = 0.05. Notifications: #eng-platform, #sre.
sam: watch error-budget and token burn.
maria: smoke checks green after 15m: p95 +0.6%, 5xx +0.02% absolute. advancing to 20%.
jeremy: keep reservoir 80% at least 24h. add alert: if token consumption > projected +15% in 1h, auto-pause.
maria: alert added. runbook updated with rollout plan. will follow up after 24h. thanks team :thumbsup:
